top_choice_rationale: P001 most sharply joins a defined TNF-based pathogenic rationale to decisive clinical establishment of a durable treatment principle. Feldmann and Maini are a compact, complementary attribution when the citation remains limited to establishing TNF blockade rather than claiming all antecedent TNF biology or subsequent drug development.
recusal_note: Documented 2009 co-authorship with Thomas Perlmann; no candidate-specific conflict is apparent.
